questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If I ____ enough money, I would buy that guitar.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대를 말하는 가정법 과거이므로 if절에는 동사의 과거형 had를 쓴다. 주절의 would buy가 단서이며 will have·have는 직설법 형태라 어울리지 않는다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If Mina ____ here now, she would help us.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 be동사는 주어에 상관없이 were를 쓴다. is·will be는 직설법이고 has been·being은 if절의 동사 자리에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If he had free time, he ____ join our book club.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 주절은 「would/could/might+동사원형」이다. will·can 등 현재형 조동사는 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법에 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If I knew her address, I ____ her a letter today.
questions.why: if절이 knew(과거형)이므로 주절은 would+동사원형인 would send가 알맞다. would have sent는 가정법 과거완료의 주절 형태다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If the weather were nice, we ____ a picnic in the park.
questions.why: if절 were에 맞추어 주절은 would+동사원형(would have)이 된다. would have had는 과거완료 가정법의 형태라 시제가 맞지 않는다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If I ____ you, I would apologize to her first.
questions.why: 「If I were you, ~」는 상대에게 충고할 때 쓰는 대표적인 가정법 과거 표현이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If Daniel studied a little harder, he ____ better grades.
questions.why: if절이 과거형 studied이므로 주절은 would get이다. will get은 직설법 조건문, would have got은 과거완료 가정법 형태다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If they ____ a car, they could travel to the coast every weekend.
questions.why: 주절이 could+동사원형이므로 if절은 과거형 had가 되어야 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거가 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If I had wings, I ____ over those mountains.
questions.why: 「If+S+과거형, S+would+동사원형」 공식에 따라 would fly가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If we ____ the answer, we would tell you right now.
questions.why: right now가 현재 사실의 반대임을 보여 주므로 if절에는 과거형 knew를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If my brother ____ taller, he could reach the top shelf.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 be동사는 were를 쓴다. 주절의 could reach가 가정법임을 알려 준다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If the bus came on time, we ____ late for school.
questions.why: if절이 came(과거형)이므로 주절은 would not+동사원형인 wouldn't be가 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If I ____ harder last month, I would have passed the test.
questions.why: 주절이 would have p.p.이므로 과거 사실의 반대를 뜻하는 가정법 과거완료이다. if절은 had studied가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If Jason had left home earlier, he ____ the 7 o'clock bus.
questions.why: if절이 had left이므로 주절은 would have p.p.인 would have caught가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If it ____ rained yesterday, the game would have started on time.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거완료이므로 if절은 had not p.p., 즉 hadn't rained가 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If they had asked me last night, I ____ them with the dishes.
questions.why: last night의 과거 사실을 뒤집는 가정법 과거완료이므로 주절은 would have helped이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If I had known about the party, I ____ a gift.
questions.why: if절 had known에 맞추어 주절은 「would have+p.p.」인 would have brought를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If Tom ____ my letter, he would have written back.
questions.why: 주절의 would have written이 가정법 과거완료임을 보여 주므로 if절은 had received여야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If the store had been open, I ____ some milk on my way home.
questions.why: 과거의 일을 반대로 가정하는 문장이므로 주절은 would have bought가 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If you ____ me yesterday, I would have picked you up at the airport.
questions.why: 주절이 would have p.p.이므로 if절은 had called가 되어야 짝이 맞는다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If we had had a map, we ____ lost in the forest.
questions.why: if절 had had에 맞추어 주절은 wouldn't have gotten이다. didn't get은 직설법 과거 표현이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If Sarah had worn a coat, she ____ a cold last winter.
questions.why: last winter의 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 주절은 wouldn't have caught가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If the phone ____ cheaper, I would buy it right away.
questions.why: 현재의 가격을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거이므로 be동사는 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If Kevin had practiced more, he ____ the piano contest.
questions.why: if절이 had practiced이므로 주절은 would have won이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If I ____ how to swim, I would join the water park trip.
questions.why: 주절이 would join이므로 if절에는 과거형 knew가 와야 가정법 과거가 완성된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If our team ____ one more goal, we would have won the match.
questions.why: 주절이 would have won이므로 if절은 had scored인 가정법 과거완료가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If Lucy lived next door, we ____ each other every day.
questions.why: if절이 lived(과거형)이므로 주절은 would see이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If the sun ____ shining, we would go to the beach.
questions.why: 가정법 과거에서는 be동사를 were로 쓰므로 were shining이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If he ____ the truth then, I would have forgiven him.
questions.why: then(그때)의 과거 사실을 뒤집는 가정법 과거완료이므로 had told를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If I ____ a smartphone, I could take better photos.
questions.why: 주절 could take에 맞추어 if절은 과거형 had를 쓴다. had had는 과거완료 가정법의 형태다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If the movie had been boring, we ____ in the middle.
questions.why: if절이 had been이므로 주절은 would have left가 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? If my parents ____ it, I would go camping with you.
questions.why: 주절이 would go이므로 if절은 과거형 allowed를 써야 가정법 과거가 된다.

questions.stem: 어법상 알맞은 것은?
choices: If I am you, I would take the job.
If I were you, I will take the job.
If I were you, I would take the job.
If I were you, I would took the job.
If I be you, I would take the job.
questions.why: 가정법 과거는 「If+S+과거형(be→were), S+would+동사원형」이다. ①은 if절이 현재형, ②는 주절이 will, ④는 주절에 과거형, ⑤는 원형을 써서 모두 틀렸다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장은?
choices: If she had come earlier, she will meet him.
If she came earlier, she would have met him.
If she had come earlier, she would have met him.
If she has come earlier, she would have met him.
If she had came earlier, she would have met him.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료는 「If+S+had p.p., S+would have p.p.」이다. ⑤는 had came이 아니라 had come이어야 하고 나머지는 두 절의 시제가 짝을 이루지 못한다.

questions.stem: 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: If I had a bike, I would ride it to school.
If it were sunny, we would go hiking.
If he studied hard, he would pass the exam.
If she were here, she will sing for us.
If they had a garden, they would grow roses.
questions.why: ④는 if절이 가정법 과거인데 주절에 will을 썼다. would sing으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: If I had known, I would have called you.
If we had hurried, we would have arrived on time.
If he had asked, I would have said yes.
If you had told me, I would have helped you.
If she had studied, she would passed the exam.
questions.why: ⑤의 주절은 would have passed가 되어야 한다. 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 「would have+p.p.」이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: If I have more time, I would read more books.
If I had more time, I would read more books.
If I had more time, I will read more books.
If I have had more time, I would read more books.
If I had more time, I would reading more books.
questions.why: 가정법 과거는 if절에 과거형, 주절에 would+동사원형을 쓴다. ②만 이 공식을 지켰다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
If we knew his number, we could call him.
If the shop were open, I would buy some bread.
If they were free, they would join us.
If Mike were rich, he will buy a yacht.
questions.why: ⑤는 주절의 will을 would로 고쳐야 한다. 가정법 과거의 주절에는 조동사의 과거형을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If I <u>were</u> rich, I <u>will</u> <u>buy</u> a small house <u>by</u> the <u>sea</u>.
questions.why: if절이 가정법 과거(were)이므로 주절의 will은 would가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If she <u>had</u> <u>studied</u> medicine, she <u>would</u> <u>became</u> a <u>doctor</u>.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 「would have+p.p.」이므로 became은 have become으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If I <u>have</u> a car, I <u>would</u> <u>drive</u> you <u>to</u> the <u>airport</u>.
questions.why: 주절이 would drive이므로 if절의 have는 과거형 had로 고쳐야 가정법 과거가 된다.

questions.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: I feel really sleepy in class every day. B: If I ____ you, I would go to bed earlier.
questions.why: 충고할 때 쓰는 「If I were you」 표현이다. 가정법 과거의 be동사는 were이다.

questions.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: I missed the last train. B: If you ____ ten minutes earlier, you would have caught it.
questions.why: B의 주절이 would have caught이므로 if절은 had left인 가정법 과거완료가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Why didn't you call me? B: I lost my phone. If I ____ your number, I would have called you.
questions.why: 과거에 전화하지 못한 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 had remembered가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은? A: Can you come to my birthday party? B: Sorry, I have to work. If I ____ free, I would come.
questions.why: 지금 한가하지 않다는 현재 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거의 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 내가 새라면, 너에게 날아갈 텐데.
choices: If I am a bird, I will fly to you.
If I were a bird, I will fly to you.
If I were a bird, I would fly to you.
If I had been a bird, I would fly to you.
If I were a bird, I would flew to you.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 「If+S+were ~, S+would+동사원형」 형태인 ③이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그때 네가 나를 도와주었더라면, 나는 그 일을 끝냈을 텐데.
choices: If you helped me then, I would finish the work.
If you had helped me then, I would finish the work.
If you had helped me then, I would have finished the work.
If you have helped me then, I would have finished the work.
If you helped me then, I would have finished the work.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대를 나타내므로 「If+S+had p.p., S+would have p.p.」인 ③이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 두 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? • If I ____ you, I would tell the truth. • If the room ____ bigger, we could dance here.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 주어에 상관없이 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 한 단어로 쓰시오. If I (be) ____ you, I would say sorry first.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 be동사는 주어에 상관없이 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Emma (know) ____ my address, she would send me a card.
questions.why: 주절이 would send이므로 if절의 동사는 과거형 knew가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 한 단어로 쓰시오. If they (have) ____ more time, they would visit the museum.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 if절에는 과거형 had를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸을 두 단어로 완성하시오. If the weather were warm, we (go) ____ to the beach.
questions.why: if절이 were이므로 주절은 「would+동사원형」인 would go가 된다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸을 두 단어로 완성하시오. If I had a ladder, I (can, reach) ____ the roof.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 주절에서는 can을 could로 바꾸어 「could+동사원형」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸을 세 단어로 완성하시오. If Jenny had left earlier, she (catch) ____ the train.
questions.why: if절이 had left이므로 주절은 「would have+p.p.」인 would have caught가 된다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오. If I (study) ____ harder last year, I would have entered that school.
questions.why: 주절이 would have entered이므로 if절은 「had+p.p.」인 had studied가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (축약형으로) If we (not, miss) ____ the bus, we would have arrived on time.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 if절은 had not p.p.이고, 축약하면 hadn't missed이다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 두 단어로 쓰시오. If he (be) ____ more careful, he would not have broken the vase.
questions.why: 주절이 would not have broken이므로 if절은 had been인 가정법 과거완료가 된다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸을 세 단어로 완성하시오. If you had told me the news, I (help) ____ you.
questions.why: if절이 had told이므로 주절은 would have helped이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If I <u>am</u> a doctor, I would help sick children for free.
questions.why: 주절이 would help이므로 if절은 가정법 과거의 be동사 were를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If she <u>will have</u> enough money, she would buy a new bag.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 if절에는 조동사 will을 쓰지 않고 동사의 과거형 had를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 세 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If we had known your plan, we <u>would call</u> you that day.
questions.why: if절이 had known이므로 주절은 「would have+p.p.」인 would have called가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 세 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If he had asked me first, I <u>will say</u> yes.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 would have p.p.이므로 will say는 would have said로 고친다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If it were sunny today, we <u>will go</u> hiking.
questions.why: if절이 가정법 과거이므로 주절의 will은 would가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If I ____ a million dollars, I would travel around the world. (have를 이용)
questions.why: 현재 가진 돈이 없다는 사실의 반대를 가정하므로 과거형 had를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If the movie ____ shorter, more people would watch it. (be를 이용)
questions.why: 가정법 과거이므로 주어가 단수라도 be동사는 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 두 단어로 쓰시오. If Mark ____ me yesterday, I would have answered right away. (call을 이용)
questions.why: 주절이 would have answered이므로 if절은 had called가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 세 단어로 쓰시오. If they had won the game, they ____ very happy. (be를 이용)
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 「would have+p.p.」이므로 would have been이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. (축약형으로) If I ____ so busy these days, I would join the drama club. (be, not을 이용)
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 부정은 were not이며 축약하면 weren't이다. wasn't는 가정법의 표준형이 아니다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If the library ____ closer to my house, I would drop by every evening.
questions.why: 주절이 would drop by이므로 if절은 가정법 과거의 be동사 were가 알맞다. if절 안에는 would를 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If people ____ less plastic, the ocean would be much cleaner.
questions.why: 주절이 「would+동사원형」이므로 if절은 과거형 used를 쓴다. had used는 주절이 would have been일 때 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If the teacher had explained it once more, we ____ the concept better in yesterday's class.
questions.why: yesterday's class라는 과거 시점의 결과이므로 「would have+p.p.」인 would have understood가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If the flight ____ on time, we would not have missed the concert last night.
questions.why: last night의 과거 사실을 뒤집는 가정법 과거완료이므로 if절은 had arrived이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If our school ____ a bigger gym, the basketball team could practice indoors.
questions.why: 주절이 could practice이므로 if절은 과거형 had가 되어 현재 사실의 반대를 나타낸다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If Amelia ____ the recipe carefully, the cake would not have burned.
questions.why: 주절이 would not have burned이므로 if절은 had read인 가정법 과거완료가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If I spoke French fluently, I ____ as a guide in Paris next summer.
questions.why: if절이 과거형 spoke인 가정법 과거이고 next summer의 일이므로 주절은 「could+동사원형」인 could work이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If the town had built a dam, the flood ____ so much damage in 2019.
questions.why: in 2019의 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 주절은 wouldn't have caused이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? If this coffee shop ____ free Wi-Fi, more students would study here.
questions.why: 주절이 would study이므로 if절은 과거형 offered를 써야 가정법 과거가 완성된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 것을 고르시오. If the guide ____ us about the storm, we would have canceled the hike.
questions.why: 주절이 would have canceled이므로 if절은 had warned가 되어야 시제 공식이 맞는다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If I (A) the class president, I (B) a suggestion box in the hallway.
questions.why: 가정법 과거는 「If+S+were, S+would+동사원형」이므로 were – would put이 알맞다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If Noah (A) the bus schedule, he (B) so long at the stop yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday의 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 「had p.p. – would not have p.p.」 형태가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If the museum (A) open on Mondays, our class (B) it tomorrow.
questions.why: 월요일에 문을 열지 않는다는 현재 사실의 반대이므로 were – would visit이 알맞다. ①은 직설법 조건문 형태다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If the actor (A) his lines, the show (B) so smoothly last night.
questions.why: last night의 일을 반대로 가정하는 가정법 과거완료이므로 「had forgotten – wouldn't have gone」이 알맞다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If my grandmother (A) a smartphone, I (B) her a video every day.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 used – would send가 알맞다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If the road (A) icy that morning, the driver (B) control of the car.
questions.why: that morning의 과거 사실을 뒤집는 문장이므로 「hadn't been – wouldn't have lost」가 알맞다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If Chris (A) allergic to peanuts, he (B) this cookie now.
questions.why: 지금 알레르기가 있다는 현재 사실의 반대이므로 「weren't – could eat」이 알맞다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If it (A) tomorrow, the school festival (B) held in the gym.
questions.why: tomorrow의 실현 가능한 일을 말하는 단순 조건문이므로 「현재형 – will+동사원형」을 쓴다. 가정법과 혼동하지 않아야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? If I had a car, I would drive you home.
choices: As I have a car, I drive you home.
As I don't have a car, I don't drive you home.
As I had a car, I drove you home.
As I didn't have a car, I didn't drive you home.
As I don't have a car, I didn't drive you home.
questions.why: 가정법 과거는 현재 사실의 반대이므로 직설법으로 바꾸면 현재시제이면서 긍정↔부정이 뒤집힌다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? If Ben had studied hard, he would have passed the exam.
choices: As Ben studies hard, he passes the exam.
As Ben doesn't study hard, he doesn't pass the exam.
As Ben didn't study hard, he didn't pass the exam.
As Ben studied hard, he passed the exam.
As Ben didn't study hard, he doesn't pass the exam.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료는 과거 사실의 반대이므로 직설법 과거시제로 바꾸고 긍정과 부정을 뒤집는다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? If it were not so cold, we would eat outside.
choices: As it is so cold, we don't eat outside.
As it isn't so cold, we eat outside.
As it was so cold, we didn't eat outside.
As it is so cold, we ate outside.
As it wasn't so cold, we didn't eat outside.
questions.why: if절이 부정이면 직설법은 긍정이 되고, 주절의 긍정은 부정이 된다. 시제는 현재로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? As I don't know his email address, I can't send him the file.
choices: If I know his email address, I can send him the file.
If I knew his email address, I could send him the file.
If I had known his email address, I could have sent him the file.
If I knew his email address, I can send him the file.
If I know his email address, I could send him the file.
questions.why: 현재 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 「If+S+과거형, S+could+동사원형」인 가정법 과거로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? As the taxi didn't come, we were late for the ceremony.
choices: If the taxi comes, we won't be late for the ceremony.
If the taxi came, we wouldn't be late for the ceremony.
If the taxi had come, we wouldn't have been late for the ceremony.
If the taxi had come, we wouldn't be late for the ceremony.
If the taxi came, we wouldn't have been late for the ceremony.
questions.why: 과거의 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 「had p.p. – would not have p.p.」인 가정법 과거완료로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? Sophie isn't tall enough, so she can't join the volleyball team.
choices: If Sophie is tall enough, she can join the volleyball team.
If Sophie were tall enough, she could join the volleyball team.
If Sophie had been tall enough, she could have joined the volleyball team.
If Sophie were tall enough, she can join the volleyball team.
If Sophie was tall enough, she will join the volleyball team.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 「were – could+동사원형」이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? If we had brought an umbrella, we wouldn't have gotten wet.
choices: As we bring an umbrella, we don't get wet.
As we don't bring an umbrella, we get wet.
As we didn't bring an umbrella, we got wet.
As we brought an umbrella, we didn't get wet.
As we didn't bring an umbrella, we don't get wet.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료를 직설법으로 옮기면 과거시제가 되고 긍정·부정이 서로 뒤바뀐다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 같은 것은? Ethan doesn't practice every day, so he isn't a good speaker.
choices: If Ethan practices every day, he is a good speaker.
If Ethan practiced every day, he would be a good speaker.
If Ethan had practiced every day, he would have been a good speaker.
If Ethan practiced every day, he will be a good speaker.
If Ethan practices every day, he would be a good speaker.
questions.why: 현재의 습관과 상태를 반대로 가정하는 것이므로 가정법 과거로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: If the app were free, more people will download it.
If the app was free, more people would downloading it.
If the app were free, more people would download it.
If the app had been free, more people would download it now and then.
If the app is free, more people would download it.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 공식 「If+S+were, S+would+동사원형」을 지킨 것은 ③뿐이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 고르시오.
choices: If the goalkeeper had jumped higher, he would stop the ball.
If the goalkeeper jumped higher, he would have stopped the ball.
If the goalkeeper has jumped higher, he would have stopped the ball.
If the goalkeeper had jumped higher, he would have stopped the ball.
If the goalkeeper had jumped higher, he will have stopped the ball.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료는 「If+S+had p.p., S+would have p.p.」이므로 ④가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르시오.
choices: If I were a scientist, I would study black holes.
If she had more free time, she would learn the cello.
If we lived by the sea, we could swim every morning.
If they were here, they would helped us with the tent.
If the shop opened earlier, I would buy breakfast there.
questions.why: ④의 주절은 would help가 되어야 한다. would 뒤에는 반드시 동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: If the train had been on time, I would have met her.
If you had worn gloves, your hands wouldn't have frozen.
If he had saved money, he could have bought the ticket.
If we had planned better, the trip would have been easier.
If they had listened, they wouldn't made the same mistake.
questions.why: ⑤는 wouldn't have made가 되어야 한다. 가정법 과거완료의 주절은 「would have+p.p.」이다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If the museum <u>had</u> <u>kept</u> the painting safely, it <u>would</u> <u>not</u> <u>disappear</u> in 1990.
questions.why: 1990년의 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하는 문장이므로 주절은 would not have disappeared가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If our team <u>practices</u> together more often, we <u>could</u> <u>have</u> a better chance <u>to</u> <u>win</u> the league this year.
questions.why: 주절이 could have인 가정법 과거이므로 if절의 practices는 과거형 practiced로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?
choices: If I were in charge, I would change the lunch menu.
If the roads were safer, children would walk to school.
If Kate had gone to bed early, she wouldn't have overslept.
If the printer had worked, we would have finished the report.
If the bridge were built last year, the traffic would be lighter.
questions.why: ⑤는 last year라는 과거 시점이 있으므로 if절이 had been built가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. If I were you, I would ask for help. ㄴ. If he had a dog, he will walk it daily. ㄷ. If they had left earlier, they would have arrived by now. ㄹ. If the soup were hotter, I would eat it. ㅁ. If she had known, she would tell us.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄷ·ㄹ이 옳다. ㄴ은 주절의 will을 would로, ㅁ은 would tell을 would have told로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home. ㄴ. If I had a passport, I would fly to Rome today. ㄷ. If she studied last night, she would have passed. ㄹ. If the box weren't so heavy, I could carry it. ㅁ. If we had booked earlier, we would have gotten better seats.
questions.why: ㄱ(단순 조건문)·ㄴ·ㄹ·ㅁ이 옳다. ㄷ은 주절이 would have passed이므로 if절이 had studied가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. If Leo were older, he could drive a car. ㄴ. If I have wings, I would fly home. ㄷ. If the light had been red, the car would have stopped. ㄹ. If we knew the password, we can open the file.
questions.why: ㄴ은 if절을 had로, ㄹ은 주절을 could open으로 고쳐야 한다. 따라서 옳은 것은 ㄱ과 ㄷ이다.

questions.stem: 어법상 틀린 문장끼리 바르게 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. If the alarm had rung, I wouldn't have been late. ㄴ. If the alarm rang, I wouldn't been late. ㄷ. If the coffee were cold, I would not drink it. ㄹ. If the coffee was cold, I will not drink it.
questions.why: ㄴ은 wouldn't be, ㄹ은 「were – would not drink」로 고쳐야 한다. ㄱ·ㄷ은 공식에 맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: If I ____ taller, I would reach the top shelf.
If the test ____ easier, more students would pass.
If he ____ my brother, I would forgive him.
If the weather ____ better, we would go sailing.
If she ____ studied medicine, she would have become a doctor.
questions.why: ①~④는 가정법 과거이므로 were가 들어가지만 ⑤는 주절이 would have become이므로 had가 들어간다.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 내가 그 소식을 알았더라면, 나는 너에게 바로 말했을 텐데.
choices: If I knew the news, I would tell you right away.
If I had known the news, I would tell you right away.
If I have known the news, I would have told you right away.
If I had known the news, I would have told you right away.
If I knew the news, I would have told you right away.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 「If+S+had p.p., S+would have p.p.」 형태인 ④가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 내가 지금 시간이 더 있다면, 나는 그 소설을 끝까지 읽을 텐데.
choices: If I have more time now, I will finish the novel.
If I had more time now, I would finish the novel.
If I had more time now, I will finish the novel.
If I had had more time now, I would finish the novel.
If I have more time now, I would finish the novel.
questions.why: now가 있으므로 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거 「had – would finish」가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그가 조금만 더 조심했더라면, 그 사고는 일어나지 않았을 텐데.
choices: If he were a little more careful, the accident wouldn't happen.
If he was a little more careful, the accident didn't happen.
If he had been a little more careful, the accident wouldn't have happened.
If he had been a little more careful, the accident wouldn't happen.
If he has been a little more careful, the accident wouldn't have happened.
questions.why: 이미 일어난 사고를 반대로 가정하므로 가정법 과거완료 형태인 ③이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 우리가 지도를 가지고 있다면, 우리는 길을 잃지 않을 텐데.
choices: If we have a map, we will not get lost.
If we had a map, we would not get lost.
If we had a map, we will not get lost.
If we had had a map, we would not get lost.
If we have a map, we would not have gotten lost.
questions.why: 현재 지도가 없다는 사실의 반대이므로 「had – would not get」인 가정법 과거를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 두 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? • If the concert ____ been canceled, we would have gone together. • If she ____ taken the earlier flight, she would have arrived by noon.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 주절이 would have p.p.인 가정법 과거완료이므로 if절에는 had가 들어간다.

questions.stem: 두 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? • If I ____ a better camera, I would take clearer pictures. • If this room ____ a window, it would feel brighter.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 과거형 had가 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: Why didn't you join the field trip last Friday? B: I was sick. If I ____ healthy, I would have gone with you.
questions.why: 지난 금요일의 과거 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 if절은 had been이 되어 주절 would have gone과 짝을 이룬다.

questions.stem: 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? A: This math problem is too hard for me. B: If I ____ how to solve it, I would explain it to you, but I don't.
questions.why: but I don't이 현재 모른다는 사실을 보여 주므로 현재 사실의 반대인 가정법 과거 knew를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 문장 한 개로 바꿔 쓰시오. I am not rich, so I can't buy that sailboat.
questions.answer: If I were rich, I could buy that sailboat.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거로 쓰고, can't는 could로 바뀌며 긍정·부정이 뒤집힌다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 문장 한 개로 바꿔 쓰시오. Emma doesn't have a bike, so she doesn't ride to school.
questions.answer: If Emma had a bike, she would ride to school.
questions.why: 직설법 현재의 부정을 가정법 과거의 긍정으로 바꾸고, 주절은 「would+동사원형」으로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 문장 한 개로 바꿔 쓰시오. I didn't bring my wallet, so I didn't buy the book.
questions.answer: If I had brought my wallet, I would have bought the book.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 「If+S+had p.p., S+would have p.p.」로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 문장 한 개로 바꿔 쓰시오. (부정은 축약형으로) He didn't set an alarm, so he missed his flight.
questions.answer: If he had set an alarm, he wouldn't have missed his flight.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료로 쓰고, 긍정과 부정을 서로 뒤집는다.
alt: If he had set an alarm, he would not have missed his flight.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 문장 한 개로 바꿔 쓰시오. We don't know her phone number, so we can't call her.
questions.answer: If we knew her phone number, we could call her.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거로 쓰고 can't는 could로 바꾼다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 문장 한 개로 바꿔 쓰시오. The room isn't quiet, so I can't concentrate on my homework.
questions.answer: If the room were quiet, I could concentrate on my homework.
questions.why: 가정법 과거에서 be동사는 were를 쓰며, can't는 could로 바뀐다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. If I were free this afternoon, I would help you with the poster. = As I ____ free this afternoon, I don't help you with the poster.
questions.why: 가정법 과거는 현재 사실의 반대이므로 직설법으로는 현재시제 부정문이 된다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Mia had taken the bus, she wouldn't have been late. = As Mia ____ take the bus, she was late.
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료를 직설법으로 바꾸면 과거시제가 되고 긍정·부정이 뒤집힌다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If it had not snowed, the mountain road wouldn't have been closed. = As it ____, the mountain road was closed.
questions.why: if절의 부정(had not snowed)은 직설법에서 긍정 과거(snowed)가 된다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Jack knew the answer, he would raise his hand. = As Jack ____ know the answer, he doesn't raise his hand.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 긍정 if절은 직설법에서 현재시제 부정이 된다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오. If the tickets were cheaper, we would go to the concert. = As the tickets ____ cheaper, we don't go to the concert.
questions.why: 가정법 과거는 현재 사실의 반대이므로 직설법에서는 현재시제 부정문이 된다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Daniel had worn a helmet, he wouldn't have hurt his head. = As Daniel ____ wear a helmet, he hurt his head.
questions.why: 과거 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법이므로 직설법은 과거시제 부정문이 된다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (부정은 축약형으로) If the elevator (not, break) ____ down yesterday, we would not have climbed twenty floors.
questions.why: 주절이 would not have climbed이므로 if절은 had not p.p., 즉 hadn't broken이 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Olivia (be) ____ on our team, we would win more games.
questions.why: 현재 사실의 반대를 나타내는 가정법 과거이므로 be동사는 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 괄호 안의 말을 이용하여 빈칸을 두 단어로 완성하시오. If the city built more parks, the air (be) ____ much cleaner.
questions.why: if절이 과거형 built이므로 주절은 「would+동사원형」인 would be가 된다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If the museum <u>has</u> opened at nine, we would have seen the whole exhibit.
questions.why: 주절이 would have seen이므로 if절은 had opened인 가정법 과거완료가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If the printer worked properly, I <u>will print</u> the report right now.
questions.why: if절이 가정법 과거(worked)이므로 주절에는 will 대신 would를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오. 내가 조금만 더 일찍 출발했더라면 (a little earlier / had / I / if / left), I would have caught the ferry.
questions.answer: If I had left a little earlier
questions.why: 가정법 과거완료의 if절은 「If+주어+had+p.p.」 순서로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 우리말과 같도록 괄호 안의 말을 바르게 배열하시오. 그녀가 지금 여기 있다면 (here / if / were / she / now), she would explain the rules to us.
questions.why: 가정법 과거의 if절은 「If+주어+were」 어순이며, 장소 부사 here 뒤에 시간 부사 now를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 last night을 넣어 가정법 과거완료 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (not은 축약하지 말 것) If I were not tired, I would join the party.
questions.answer: If I had not been tired last night, I would have joined the party.
questions.why: 과거의 일을 반대로 가정하므로 if절은 had not been, 주절은 would have joined이 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If Marcus had accepted the scholarship three years ago, he ____ at a research lab in Boston now.
questions.why: 과거의 일(장학금 거절)이 현재의 결과로 이어지는 혼합 가정법이다. now가 있으므로 주절은 「would+동사원형」이 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If I hadn't skipped breakfast this morning, I ____ so hungry now.
questions.why: if절은 과거(가정법 과거완료), 주절은 now가 붙은 현재 결과이므로 혼합 가정법의 wouldn't be가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If Ella had followed her doctor's advice last year, she ____ much healthier today.
questions.why: today라는 현재 시점의 결과를 말하므로 주절에 「would+동사원형」을 쓰는 혼합 가정법이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If the company had invested in new technology in the 1990s, it ____ the market leader today.
questions.why: 과거의 원인 + 현재의 결과이므로 혼합 가정법 「had p.p. ~ would+동사원형」을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If we had reserved the tickets last week, we ____ in the front row right now.
questions.why: right now의 현재 상황을 말하므로 주절은 「would+동사원형」 형태인 would be sitting이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If Julia had learned to drive in her twenties, she ____ to work every morning instead of taking two buses.
questions.why: 과거에 배우지 않은 결과가 현재의 습관으로 이어지는 혼합 가정법이므로 would drive를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If Peter ____ so careless a person, he wouldn't have lost his passport in Rome last summer.
questions.why: '원래 부주의한 성격'이라는 현재의 사실을 반대로 가정하고 결과는 과거이므로 if절에는 가정법 과거의 weren't를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If Nora spoke Japanese as well as her sister does, she ____ the overseas position last month.
questions.why: if절은 현재의 능력을 반대로 가정하고 결과는 last month의 과거이므로 주절은 「would have+p.p.」가 된다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If I ____ afraid of heights, I would have joined the paragliding tour in Nepal last winter.
questions.why: 고소공포증이 있다는 현재의 성향을 반대로 가정하므로 if절은 weren't이고, 결과는 과거이므로 주절은 would have joined이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If the old bridge had not collapsed in 2018, the two villages ____ still connected by a single road today.
questions.why: 과거의 붕괴가 현재의 상태에 영향을 주는 혼합 가정법이므로 주절은 would be이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If my parents had settled in Canada before I was born, I ____ English as my first language now.
questions.why: 과거의 조건이 현재의 결과로 이어지므로 now와 함께 would speak를 쓰는 혼합 가정법이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? If Amy had backed up her files properly, she ____ to rewrite the entire report now.
questions.why: 지금 다시 써야 하는 현재의 결과를 말하므로 혼합 가정법의 주절인 wouldn't have to가 알맞다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If the team had prepared more carefully, they (A) the trophy last season, and they (B) the defending champions this year.
choices: would have won – would have been
questions.why: last season의 결과는 「would have+p.p.」, this year의 결과는 「would+동사원형」이다. 한 문장 안에서 가정법 과거완료와 혼합 가정법이 함께 쓰였다.

questions.stem: (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은? If Leo (A) his ankle during the final match, he (B) with the national team right now.
questions.why: 과거의 부상이 현재의 상황을 결정하는 혼합 가정법이므로 「hadn't injured – wouldn't be training」이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 가정법의 종류가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the last train.
If they had checked the map, they wouldn't have taken the wrong road.
If he had studied engineering, he would be working at a car company now.
If I had listened to her, I wouldn't have made that mistake.
If we had booked in advance, we would have paid much less.
questions.why: ③만 과거의 원인과 현재의 결과를 이은 혼합 가정법이고, 나머지는 모두 가정법 과거완료이다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장의 뜻 차이를 바르게 설명한 것은? (A) If he had taken the medicine, he would have felt better. (B) If he had taken the medicine, he would feel better now.
choices: (A)는 현재 사실의 반대이고, (B)는 미래의 일을 나타낸다.
questions.why: (A)는 가정법 과거완료로 과거의 결과를, (B)는 혼합 가정법으로 now가 가리키는 현재의 결과를 말한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은? • If the storm (A) the harbor last night, the ferries would be running today. • If Mia (B) more sociable, she would have made friends at the camp.
questions.why: 첫 문장은 과거 원인·현재 결과의 혼합 가정법이므로 hadn't damaged, 둘째 문장은 현재의 성격을 반대로 가정하므로 were가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: If I <u>had</u> more courage, I would speak up in meetings.
If she <u>had</u> a driver's license, she would rent a car.
If the hotel <u>had</u> a pool, we would stay there again.
If they <u>had</u> arrived on time, we would be eating dinner now.
If he <u>had</u> a quieter room, he would sleep better.
questions.why: ①·②·③·⑤의 had는 가정법 과거의 본동사이지만, ④의 had는 had arrived를 이루는 조동사로 혼합 가정법의 if절을 만든다.

questions.stem: 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: If I would have known your schedule, I would have changed the meeting.
If I had known your schedule, I would have changed the meeting.
If I have known your schedule, I would change the meeting.
If I knew your schedule, I would have change the meeting.
If I had knew your schedule, I would have changed the meeting.
questions.why: if절 안에는 would를 쓰지 않고 had p.p.를 쓴다. ⑤의 had knew는 had known이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르게 쓰인 것은?
choices: If the coach had chosen her, the team would win the final now.
If the coach had chosen her, the team would be in the final now.
If the coach chose her, the team would have been in the final now.
If the coach had chosen her, the team will be in the final now.
If the coach has chosen her, the team would be in the final now.
questions.why: 혼합 가정법은 「If+S+had p.p., S+would+동사원형」이며 주절에 now 같은 현재 시점 부사가 온다. ①은 would win the final now라는 의미가 성립하지 않는다.

questions.stem: 어법상 어색한 문장을 고르시오.
choices: If Ben had trained regularly, he would be in better shape today.
If the law had passed, the situation would be different now.
If I had chosen another major, I would work in a hospital now.
If we had left at dawn, we would be halfway there by now.
If she had taken that flight, she would arrived in Paris yesterday.
questions.why: ⑤는 yesterday라는 과거 시점의 결과이므로 would have arrived가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 잘못된 문장은?
choices: If the museum weren't so far, I would visit it every weekend.
If the report had been submitted on time, we wouldn't be in trouble now.
If he were more patient, he wouldn't have quit the project last month.
If I had had your address, I would have sent you a postcard.
If they were more careful, they wouldn't have broke the window.
questions.why: ⑤의 broke는 과거분사 broken이어야 한다. 「would not have+p.p.」 형태를 지켜야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If the researchers <u>had</u> <u>share</u> their data earlier, other teams <u>would</u> <u>be</u> able to repeat the experiment today.
questions.why: 가정법의 if절은 「had+과거분사」이므로 share를 shared로 고쳐야 한다. today가 있으므로 주절은 「would+동사원형」인 would be가 맞다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? If our ancestors <u>hadn't</u> <u>learned</u> to cook food, our brains <u>would</u> <u>have developed</u> <u>quite</u> differently today.
questions.why: today가 가리키는 현재의 상태를 말하는 혼합 가정법이므로 have developed를 동사원형 develop으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 다섯 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: If I hadn't met my mentor, I wouldn't be a teacher today.
If I didn't meet my mentor, I wouldn't be a teacher today.
If I hadn't met my mentor, I wouldn't have been a teacher today.
If I haven't met my mentor, I wouldn't be a teacher today.
If I wouldn't have met my mentor, I wouldn't be a teacher today.
questions.why: 과거의 만남이 현재의 직업을 결정하므로 「hadn't met – wouldn't be」의 혼합 가정법이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것을 고르시오.
choices: If the rain had stopped, the parade would be starting now.
If she were on duty tonight, she would have answered the call an hour ago.
If we had recycled more, the landfill wouldn't be full today.
If he had had more experience, he would handle the crisis better now.
If they had not argued, they would still been friends today.
questions.why: ⑤는 would still be friends가 되어야 한다. 혼합 가정법의 주절에는 「would+동사원형」을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. If the train had been delayed, we would still be waiting at the platform. ㄴ. If I had not eaten so much, I would not feel sick now. ㄷ. If he had studied abroad, he would have speak three languages now. ㄹ. If she were taller, she would have been chosen for the team last year. ㅁ. If we had known the rules, we would play differently yesterday.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄴ·ㄹ이 옳다. ㄷ은 would speak, ㅁ은 yesterday에 맞게 would have played가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ㄱ. If I would be you, I would take the offer. ㄴ. If the soil had been richer, the village would be wealthier today. ㄷ. If Amy weren't so shy, she would have introduced herself yesterday. ㄹ. If they had booked earlier, they would be flying business class now. ㅁ. If we had missed the last ferry, we would be waiting at the port yesterday.
questions.why: ㄴ·ㄷ·ㄹ이 옳다. ㄱ은 If I were you로, ㅁ은 yesterday와 맞지 않으므로 would have been waiting 형태로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. If the factory had closed, hundreds of families would be struggling now. ㄴ. If the factory closed, hundreds of families would have struggled now. ㄷ. If I had returned the book, I wouldn't owe a fine today. ㄹ. If I had returned the book, I won't owe a fine today.
questions.why: ㄴ은 now와 would have struggled가 어울리지 않고, ㄹ은 주절에 won't 대신 wouldn't를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 어법상 틀린 문장끼리 바르게 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. If the surgeon had operated sooner, the patient would be walking today. ㄴ. If the surgeon operated sooner, the patient would be walking today. ㄷ. If I were a fluent speaker, I would have led the discussion last week. ㄹ. If I had been a fluent speaker, I would have lead the discussion last week.
questions.why: ㄴ은 과거의 수술을 가정하므로 had operated여야 하고, ㄹ은 lead가 아니라 과거분사 led를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
choices: If Sam ____ taken the job, he would be living in Busan now.
If we ____ saved more, we wouldn't be worried about the rent today.
If the door ____ been locked, the cat wouldn't have escaped.
If I ____ your number, I would call you right now.
If they ____ warned us, we wouldn't be stuck here.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은? If the medicine hadn't worked, he would still be in the hospital.
choices: As the medicine worked, he isn't in the hospital now.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은? As I am not good at drawing, I didn't enter the poster contest last month.
choices: If I were good at drawing, I would enter the poster contest.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은? As the government didn't repair the dam, the fields are flooded now.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은? If Grace had majored in design, she wouldn't be working as an accountant today.
choices: As Grace majored in design, she is working as an accountant today.

questions.stem: 다음 문장과 뜻이 가장 가까운 것은? As Owen isn't a member of the club, he wasn't invited to the opening party.
choices: If Owen were a member of the club, he would be invited to the opening party.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 내가 그때 그 조언을 받아들였더라면, 나는 지금 훨씬 마음이 편할 텐데.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 그가 내성적이지 않다면, 그는 어제 무대에서 노래했을 텐데.

questions.stem: 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은? 우리가 그 회사를 더 일찍 떠났더라면, 우리는 지금 우리만의 사업을 하고 있을 텐데.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? Sam moved to the countryside ten years ago. If he ____ in the city, he would be paying a much higher rent today.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? The lecture was canceled without notice. If the office ____ us in advance, we wouldn't be standing in the rain now.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? Helen is not a careful reader. If she ____, she would have noticed the mistake on page 3 yesterday.
questions.why: '그녀는 꼼꼼한 독자가 아니다'라는 현재의 사실을 반대로 가정하므로 if절은 가정법 과거의 were이고, 결과는 어제의 일이므로 주절은 would have noticed이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? Ancient sailors relied on the stars. If they had not studied the night sky so carefully, long ocean voyages ____ impossible for centuries.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은? My grandfather sold the farmland in 1985. If he had kept it, our family ____ a small orchard there today.
questions.why: 1985년의 과거 행동과 today의 현재 결과를 잇는 혼합 가정법이므로 would run이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. I didn't take the medicine, so I don't feel better now.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. Grace didn't study Spanish, so she can't work in Madrid now.
questions.answer: If Grace had studied Spanish, she could work in Madrid now.
questions.why: 혼합 가정법에서 직설법의 can't는 주절의 could로 바뀐다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. (부정은 축약형으로) Ben lost his wallet yesterday, so he can't pay for lunch now.
questions.answer: If Ben hadn't lost his wallet yesterday, he could pay for lunch now.

questions.why: 현재의 사실을 반대로 가정하고 결과는 지난달의 과거이므로 「were – would have entered」가 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 If로 시작하는 가정법 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. Jane isn't tall, so she wasn't chosen as a model last year.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If I had saved more money, I would be traveling in Europe now. = As I ____ save more money, I am not traveling in Europe now.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Tom hadn't broken his leg, he would be playing in today's match. = As Tom ____ his leg, he isn't playing in today's match.
questions.why: if절의 부정(hadn't broken)은 직설법에서 긍정 과거 broke가 된다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If the villagers had built a wall, the fields wouldn't be flooded now. = As the villagers ____ build a wall, the fields are flooded now.
questions.why: 과거의 원인은 직설법 과거 부정으로, 현재의 결과는 현재시제 긍정으로 바뀐다.

questions.stem: 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오. If Sue weren't so shy, she would have joined the debate last week. = As Sue ____ so shy, she didn't join the debate last week.
questions.why: if절이 가정법 과거이므로 직설법에서는 현재시제 긍정문 is가 된다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 세 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If she weren't so busy with her research, she <u>would attend</u> the ceremony last Friday.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. If we had left at dawn as planned, we <u>will</u> be crossing the border by now.
